title: Access and use Technology lending library
issue: You need to access or request Technology lending library
resolution_html:
1. Confirm the requested equipment and your eligibility with the UIT Service Desk
  2. Bring your YU-card and departmental budget number to the Steacie Service Desk
  3. Review and sign the required lending agreement and return equipment by the agreed due date

For a problem, contact askIT and include the service and any error shown
